proposal.summary: Incorrect permission assignment on the installation folder in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) < 3.5.3 allows a local user of the PC to gain wide privileges, potentially destroying the system or executing a malicious program.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed, therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

AV.quote: a user of the PC where the affected product is installed

AC.quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed

PR.quote: a user of the PC where the affected product is installed

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the issue on an instance of CONPROSYS CHS < 3.5.3 by inspecting ACLs on the product installation folder and attempting local misuse; contact the vendor to request a patch or guidance to set least-privilege ACLs on the installation directory.

evidence_quotes.quote: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed, therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.
the user may be able to destroy the system
